description: Land Title Settlement Department  - Ginipendegama, Wariyapola D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420911
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, land extents, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content falls under "Land registrations, property ownership, land titles" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, and appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette.
